answer: A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, as the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The comet multiplier is published, charged in gale, and cipher lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 12 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 2888 identities would post 1699 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
